title: Please Put Them On, Takamine-san
native: 履いてください、鷹峰さん
synopsis:
Takane Takamine is the goddess of her high school. With perfect grades, athletic prowess, and unrivaled beauty, this student council president is the apple of everyone's eye-including Koushi Shirota, a below-average student with no friends or social prospects whatsoever. But he'll soon find out the secret behind Takamine's unbelievable success-her underwear! When she strips, she can undo any of her past actions, and now that Koushi knows, Takamine won't let him off so easy...

(Source: Yen Press)

episodes.title: Become My Closet
episodes.synopsis:
Takamine is basically a goddess. Shirota is like an NPC, but he glimpses her bare breasts. Weirdness ensues...

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Let Me Redo It Until I'm Satisfied.
episodes.synopsis:
It's Shirota's first day as Takamine's closet. How is he even supposed to pull off what she's asking of him?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: I Want You to Enjoy the Very Best
episodes.synopsis:
Shirota learns how much effort Takamine has put into being who she is. Later, she helps him get first place.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Don't Be Dense, Be Sharp.
episodes.synopsis:
When Shirota gets sick, Takamine nurses him with surprising devotion, making him wonder if it means something.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: I Want You to Make This Cat Purr, Meow.
episodes.synopsis:
Shirota is over at Takamine's place, but then the lightning knocks out the power and sends her into his arms.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Honey, Let Me Wash Your Back.
episodes.synopsis:
Takamine and Shirota roleplay newlyweds. She escalates things by joining him in the bath to wash his back.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Even That Which Isn't Visible From There
episodes.synopsis:
Takamine and Shirota talk about the future. When he says he's set on work, not college, she briefly looks sad.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: You Two Seem Quite Intimate
episodes.synopsis:
Shirota runs into Ellie, a friend from grade school. They're hanging out in the park where Takamine sees them.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Let Me Do It!!
episodes.synopsis:
Takamine challenges Shirota to a water balloon fight, the loser has to obey the winner. What will it be?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: It Rains, and Shirota Freezes Up
episodes.synopsis:
The class will put on the play Cinderella. Naturally, Takamine will be Cinderella, but who will be the prince?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: I'll Let You Do a Dry Run
episodes.synopsis:
To calm Shirota's nerves, Takamine goes into the haunted house with him. It works, but now where is Ouji?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Only Look At Me
episodes.synopsis:
Can Shirota make it to the end of Cinderella without messing up? Near the end, something unexpected happens!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
